title: Jumping up and down: Denoiser diffusion models for discrete ordinal data
title_zh: 上下跳跃：用于离散序数据的去噪扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models are highly developed in continuous spaces for image and video domains. Recently, major advances have been made for discrete diffusion models for categorical data, specifically in the language domain. In contrast, diffusion models for discrete integer-valued data are less developed, despite the prevalence of this modality, ranging from images and music to gene counts. We introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD)—a new family of denoiser-based diffusion models for discrete ordinal data. This is the first family of diffusion models for ordinal data which centers around training denoisers, which at the same time allows for bi-directional (up and down) perturbations of the data. The simplicity of the training objective, combined with the flexibility of bi-directional perturbations, leads us to obtain competitive results across different data modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型在图像和视频领域的连续空间中已得到高度发展。 最近，离散扩散模型在分类数据领域取得了重大进展，尤其是在语言领域。 相比之下，针对离散整数值数据的扩散模型发展尚不成熟，尽管这种数据形式广泛存在，从图像、音乐到基因计数不一而足。 我们提出了“跳跃上升与下降”（JUD）——一种基于去噪器的新型扩散模型家族，专为离散序数数据设计。 这是首个针对序数数据的扩散模型家族，其核心是训练去噪器，同时支持对数据进行双向（向上和向下）扰动。 简单的训练目标与双向扰动的灵活性相结合，使我们能够在不同数据模态上获得具有竞争力的结果。

paragraphs.en: The success of diffusion models in continuous domains such as image and video is driving an explosion of activity in applying diffusion models for discrete data. The vast majority of diffusion models for discrete data focus on language where the data is categorical , that is, a data modality with no natural order. In contrast, in many applications the discrete data also contains a natural order, i.e., the data is ordinal as its distribution is over (subsets of) ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} or ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} . This modality naturally shows up in images (8-bit digital grayscale from 0 to 255), music (MIDI note numbers from 0 to 127), tabular data (amount in dollars of debt/credit), and in scientific applications ranging from biology (gene expression counts in cells) to chemistry (number of atoms in molecules). In addition to the aforementioned applications of discrete ordinal data, this modality is also interesting from the theoretical perspective as it lies in some sense between categorical and continuous data: On the one hand, the data is discrete as in categorical data, while on the other hand the data has an intrinsic order as in continuous data in ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} . Despite the importance of discrete ordinal data, the theory and practice of diffusion models for this modality are still developing. In this paper we contribute to both.

paragraphs.en: In continuous spaces, the Gaussian noise blurs the data in all directions. For ordinal data, a data point in ℕ \mathbb{N} or ℤ \mathbb{Z} can be perturbed either up, or down, or both. As we will see below, uni-directional perturbations (either just up or just down) give rise to denoiser-based training and sampling (cf. Appendix D ). That is, provided a suitable choice of up-perturbation, or down-perturbation, we can train an appropriate denoiser m data \mathrm{m}_{\textnormal{data}} and then use it to sample from the data distribution. But perturbing the data in only one direction can lead to inaccurate samplers. This is because once the sampler over/undershoots, due to inevitable approximation errors, the process cannot “undo” prior mistakes and correct the trajectory evolution. This is evident in Figure 1 when comparing Binomial-Poisson (one of our up-and-down methods), Binomial (only down) and Poisson (only up). Hence, our goal is to find perturbations and samplers which allow for up and down jumps, while at the same time being denoiser-based . This is a non-trivial task, as the up and down perturbations can interact in arbitrarily complex ways, which was not accomplished in previous works; for space reasons, related works are discussed in Appendix I . This is precisely the goal that we will achieve in this paper.

paragraphs.en: We develop a novel framework of denoiser-based diffusion models (JUD) for discrete ordinal data on ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} and ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} . Our key innovation is to train latent denoisers which predict partially noised data . Our main result ( Theorem 2.1 ) shows that the latent denoisers are sufficient to sample from the data distribution via a stochastic process which allows for Up-and-Down moves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} 和 ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} 上的离散序数据开发了一种基于去噪器的扩散模型（JUD）的新框架。 我们的关键创新在于训练潜隐去噪器，以预测部分被添加噪声的数据。 我们的主要成果（定理 2.1）表明，通过允许“上-下”移动的随机过程，潜隐去噪器足以从数据分布中采样。

paragraphs.en: The perturbations ( 5 ) and ( 6 ) are very simple, but finding CTMCs whose marginals match these perturbations, which at the same time can take advantage of denoiser-based training, is not obvious and has been missing so far. In this work we construct CTMCs whose marginals match Equation 5 or Equation 6 , which can be trained using only latent denoisers. Our key innovation is to train, in each of the perturbations ( 5 ) and ( 6 ), latent denoisers which denoise not the data itself, but partially noised data . paragraphs.en: The crux of Theorem 2.1 is that once the latent denoisers ( m latent-down , m latent-up ) (\mathrm{m}_{\textnormal{{latent-down}}},\mathrm{m}_{\textnormal{{latent-up}}}) are trained, we can approximately sample from p data p_{\textnormal{data}} using any sampling algorithm for CTMCs, with the initial distribution Poisson ⁡ ( a ) \operatorname{Poisson}(a) (Binomial-Poisson) or Skellam ⁡ ( b , a ) \operatorname{Skellam}(b,a) (Poisson-Poisson). paragraphs.en: We test the Binomial-Poisson model of Theorem 2.1 on the hard Sudoku benchmark of Deschenaux & Gulcehre (2026) . Each puzzle has 30 visible digits and a unique solution. paragraphs.en: We use the benchmark’s DiT backbone configuration. We use the same linear-time schedules as in CIFAR-10, with mean digit value 5. CE instead learns a nine-class distribution for each digit, conditioned on the perturbed solution and context; see Section 2.2 . The denoiser(s) follow analytically from this posterior ( Section H.2 ). A single network evaluation returns two scalar outputs per cell for MSE or nine logits for CE. paragraphs.en: In this work we introduce Jumping Up and Down (JUD) : a denoiser-based family of generative diffusion models for discrete ordinal data (either ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} or ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} ) which allows for bi-directional perturbations . Our main result ( Theorem 2.1 ) shows that it suffices to learn latent denoisers in order to sample from the data distribution. Further, we show that theoretically a single denoiser suffices to sample from the data distribution, as the two latent denoisers can be expressed in terms of each other. In addition, we also prove that the data denoiser can be expressed in terms of the latent denoiser(s). We validate our methods on synthetic datasets, CIFAR-10, and the Sudoku completion task. In particular, on synthetic datasets we often obtain superior results over alternative discrete diffusion models, and we achieve a state-of-the-art result among discrete diffusion models for CIFAR-10.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了“上下跳跃”（Jumping Up and Down，JUD）：一种基于去噪器的生成扩散模型家族，适用于离散序数据（即 ℕ^D 或 ℤ^D），并支持双向扰动。 我们的主要成果（定理 2.1）表明，只需学习潜在去噪器即可从数据分布中采样。 此外，我们从理论上证明，仅使用一个去噪器就足以从数据分布中采样，因为两个潜在去噪器可以相互表示。 另外，我们还证明了数据去噪器可以用潜在去噪器来表示。 我们在合成数据集、CIFAR-10 以及数独补全任务上验证了我们的方法。 特别是在合成数据集上，我们的方法通常优于其他离散扩散模型；在 CIFAR-10 任务中，我们实现了当前最先进的结果。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models in discrete time were first introduced in Sohl-Dickstein et al. (2015) with an evidence lower bound (ELBO) training objective. The method was then further developed in Ho et al. (2020) ; Song et al. (2021a) , where the connection to denoising score matching was made, with additionally better parameterizations and sampling, which ultimately led to a state-of-the-art (at the time) FID score of 3.17 on CIFAR-10. The progression of diffusion models to continuous-time as reverse-time stochastic differential equations was developed in Song et al. (2021b) , which also unified diffusion models with the score matching with Langevin dynamics framework ( Song & Ermon, 2019 ) . Song et al. (2021b) wrote the training objective as denoising score matching, and lowered the FID score on CIFAR-10 to 2.20. In Karras et al. (2022) , the design space for training the denoiser was explored systematically, which further brought down the FID to 1.97 on CIFAR-10. The EDM framework developed in Karras et al. (2022) is regularly used in state-of-the-art results for image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 离散时间扩散模型最早由 Sohl-Dickstein 等人（2015）提出，其训练目标为证据下界（ELBO）。随后，Ho 等人（2020）和 Song 等人（2021a）对该方法进行了进一步改进，并将其与去噪分数匹配建立了联系，同时引入了更优的参数化和采样策略，最终在 CIFAR-10 数据集上取得了当时最先进的 FID 分数 3.17。Song 等人（2021b）将扩散模型推广至连续时间形式，即反向时间随机微分方程，同时将扩散模型与基于朗之万动力学的分数匹配框架（Song & Ermon, 2019）进行了统一。Song 等人（2021b）将训练目标表述为去噪分数匹配，并将 CIFAR-10 上的 FID 分数降至 2.20。在 Karras 等人（2022）的研究中，研究人员系统性地探索了去噪器训练的设计空间，进一步将 CIFAR-10 上的 FID 分数降低至 1.97。Karras 等人（2022）提出的 EDM 框架目前常被用于生成图像领域的最先进结果中。

paragraphs.en: Repeating history, the first diffusion models for categorical data were developed in discrete time ( Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ) , while the continuous time formulation was later developed in Campbell et al. paragraphs.en: Already at the origin of diffusion models, ordinal data appeared in the form of binary data ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) , with later developments in Bach & Saremi (2025) ; Bénédict et al. (2023) ; Pham et al. (2025) . In some biological applications, e.g., gene expression counts in single-cell RNA sequencing, recent works ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Bhattacharya et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) argued that it is beneficial to develop diffusion models that act directly on the discrete data, but these works neglect the ordinal structure and use categorical discrete diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散模型的起源阶段，序数数据就已经以二元数据的形式出现（Sohl-Dickstein 等人，2015），随后 Bach & Saremi（2025）、Bénédict 等人（2023）以及 Pham 等人（2025）的研究也取得了进展。 在某些生物学应用中，例如单细胞 RNA 测序中的基因表达计数，近期的研究（Zhang 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026b；Bhattacharya 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026a）指出，开发能够直接作用于离散数据的扩散模型是有益的，但这些研究忽略了序数结构，并使用了分类离散扩散模型。

paragraphs.en: The theory and practice for the ordinal data considered in this work, namely (subsets of) ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} or ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} , has only recently started to evolve. Let us begin with data on ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} . One approach, developed in Chen & Zhou (2023) ; Montanari (2023) ; Bhattacharya et al. (2025) , learns both a denoiser and a rate via a discrete Tweedie’s formula, but using perturbation of the form 𝐱 data ↦ X t ∼ Poisson ⁡ ( t ​ 𝐱 data ) \mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}}\mapsto X_{t}\sim\operatorname{Poisson}(t\,\mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}}) . This type of perturbation can only recover the clean data in the limit τ → ∞ \tau\to\infty , in contrast to our approach which recovers 𝐱 data \mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}} at a final time. In addition, this perturbation can easily overshoot the effective support of the data. Alternative approaches ( Santos et al., 2023 ; Santos et al., 2025 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) use only Binomial noise, which suffers from being a uni-directional perturbation. Another uni-directional perturbation was developed in Campbell et al. (2023) . In Winkler et al. (2024) ; Wei & Pearson (2026) , an up-down perturbation based on Binomial noise is developed. However, this formulation does not allow for a direct training of a denoiser. In Fishman et al. (2026) , the Poisson-Poisson perturbation ( 6 ) is used, but the denoiser formulation of Theorem C.1 is lacking, which leads Fishman et al. (2026) to a distributional training objective. Similarly, the concurrent work Wei (2026) considers a Binomial-Poisson perturbation ( 7 ), but is also lacking a denoiser representation and trains using the generator matching framework ( Holderrieth et al., 2025 ) . To summarize, our work is the first to train a diffusion model for discrete ordinal data which allows for up-down perturbations, while training only denoisers.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究中涉及的序数数据的理论与实践，即（自然数集或整数集的）子集 ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} 或 ℤ D \mathbb{Z}^{D} ，直到最近才开始发展。我们从 ℕ D \mathbb{N}^{D} 上的数据开始讨论。一种方法由 Chen & Zhou (2023)；Montanari (2023)；Bhattacharya et al. (2025) 提出，该方法通过离散 Tweedie 公式同时学习去噪器和速率，但使用的是形如 𝐱 data ↦ X t ∼ Poisson ⁡ ( t ​ 𝐱 data ) \mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}}\mapsto X_{t}\sim\operatorname{Poisson}(t\,\mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}}) 的扰动。与我们的方法不同，这种扰动仅在极限 τ → ∞ \tau\to\infty 时才能恢复原始数据，而我们的方法则能在最终时刻恢复 𝐱 data \mathbf{x}_{\textnormal{data}}。此外，这种扰动很容易超出数据的有效支撑范围。其他替代方法（Santos et al., 2023；Santos et al., 2025；Shenfeld et al., 2026；Cheng et al., 2026）仅使用二项式噪声，但这种方法存在单向扰动的缺陷。Campbell et al. (2023) 提出另一种单向扰动。在 Winkler et al. (2024)；Wei & Pearson (2026) 中，研究人员开发了一种基于二项式噪声的上下扰动方法。然而，这种形式无法直接训练去噪器。Fishman et al. (2026) 使用了泊松-泊松扰动（6），但缺少定理 C.1 中的去噪器形式，这导致 Fishman et al. (2026) 不得不采用分布训练目标。同样，同步进行的 Wei (2026) 的研究考虑了二项式-泊松扰动（7），但也缺乏去噪器的表示形式，并采用生成器匹配框架（Holderrieth et al., 2025）进行训练。总而言之，我们的研究是首个为离散序数数据训练扩散模型的工作，该模型支持上下扰动，并且仅通过训练去噪器实现。
